locators: Page 1, Indications for use
text: US labeling indicates Neuroform Atlas with neurovascular embolic coils for patients age 18 or older with wide-neck intracranial saccular aneurysms arising from a 2.0-4.5 mm parent vessel that are not amenable to surgical clipping; wide neck is defined as neck at least 4 mm or dome-to-neck ratio below 2.

locators: Page 1, Contraindications
text: US labeling contraindicates Neuroform Atlas in patients for whom antiplatelet and/or anticoagulation therapy is contraindicated.

locators: Page 1, Warnings, fifth bullet
text: Select stent length to maintain at least 4 mm beyond each side of the aneurysm neck along the parent vessel; the labeling states that the stent is not designed for an aneurysm neck longer than 22 mm.

locators: Page 1, Cautions / precautions, fifth bullet
text: The labeling states that Neuroform Atlas may foreshorten by up to 6.3% after deployment.

locators: Page 1, Cautions / precautions, sixth and seventh bullets
text: The coiling microcatheter maximum outer diameter should not exceed that of the stent-delivery microcatheter; standard interventional devices with distal tips greater than 1.8 F may not pass through the stent interstices.

locators: Page 1, Magnetic Resonance Imaging Safety Information
text: The implant is MR Conditional immediately after placement at 1.5 or 3.0 T, with maximum spatial gradient 2500 G/cm, whole-body averaged SAR 2 W/kg, and head-averaged SAR 3.2 W/kg; the stated maximum temperature rise applies after 15 minutes of continuous scanning under those conditions.
